title: Prisma in Pages Router API Routes
description: Maintain legacy Next.js Pages Router API routes (pages/api/*) with Prisma, type-safe request handlers, and middleware.

data.text: While modern Next.js projects adopt the App Router, millions of existing production codebases still run on the **Pages Router** (`pages/api/...`). In the Pages Router, API endpoints are standard Node.js request/response handlers (`NextApiRequest`, `NextApiResponse`).

data.title: pages/api/users/[id].ts
data.content: Pages router API endpoint handling GET and DELETE requests.

data.title: Key Takeaways
points: Pages Router API routes use `(req: NextApiRequest, res: NextApiResponse)`.
Use the same `lib/prisma.ts` singleton across Pages Router and App Router.
Explicitly handle HTTP method branching and 405 Method Not Allowed.
